## Key Query Parameters

The `?bundle` parameter controls bundling strategy, with `?bundle=false` disabling default sub-module bundling. The `?target` parameter sets compatibility target (e.g., es2022, denonext).

# esm.sh Query Parameters

Here are the supported query parameters and their functions:

## **?exports=** (Tree Shaking)
Specifies which named exports to bundle together. Reduces file size by isolating only needed members.

**Syntax:** `https://esm.sh/tslib?exports=__await,__rest`

Creates a smaller module (489B vs 7.3KB) containing only the specified exports. Works with ES modules but not CommonJS.

## **?bundle=false**
Disables default bundling of sub-modules.

**Syntax:** `https://esm.sh/svelte?bundle=false`

Prevents bundling behavior that can reduce network requests but may duplicate shared modules.

## **?standalone**
Bundles the module with all external dependencies (excluding peer dependencies) into a single file.

**Syntax:** `https://esm.sh/antd?standalone`

## **?css**
Imports CSS files that packages load directly into JavaScript.

**Syntax:** `<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://esm.sh/monaco-editor?css">`

## **?target=**
Specifies the ECMAScript build target.

**Syntax:** `https://esm.sh/react?target=es2022`

Available targets: es2015–es2024, esnext, deno, denonext, node.

## **?deps=**
Specifies dependency versions to rewrite import specifiers.

**Syntax:** `https://esm.sh/swr?deps=react@18.3.1`

Multiple dependencies: `?deps=react@18.3.1,react-dom@18.3.1`

## **?external**
Marks dependencies as external, letting browsers/Deno resolve them via import maps.

**Syntax:** `https://esm.sh/preact-render-to-string@5.2.0?external=preact`

Use `*` prefix to mark all dependencies external: `https://esm.sh/*swr@1.3.0`

## **?raw**
Requests source files without transformation into ES modules.

**Syntax:** `https://esm.sh/p5/lib/p5.min.js?raw`

Equivalent to `https://raw.esm.sh/<PATH>`.

---

**Note:** The `?exports` parameter produces a single URL returning only the specified exports, making it useful for cherry-picking components without importing the entire library.

## Report: `@pantoken/components` CSS package — CDN distribution analysis

### Package location and identity
- Package directory: `formats/components/` (relative to repo root)
- Exact package name: `@pantoken/components` (version `0.1.1`)
- README notes it's also aliased as `pantoken/components`.

### 1. package.json fields (`formats/components/package.json`)

- **`name`**: `@pantoken/components`
- **`files`**: `["dist", "assets/fonts"]` — only the `dist/` output and the font woff2s are published. The `generated/` dir is an intermediate build artifact and is NOT shipped.
- **`type`**: `module`
- **`main`/`module`/`style`**: none of these legacy fields exist. Entry resolution is entirely via the `exports` map.
- **`sideEffects`**: NOT present (no `sideEffects` field at all).
- **`exports`** map:
  ```json
  {
    ".":              "./dist/index.mjs",
    "./base.css":     "./dist/base.css",
    "./components.css":"./dist/components.css",
    "./*.css":        "./dist/*.css",
    "./fonts.css":    "./dist/fonts.css",
    "./prose.css":    "./dist/prose.css",
    "./select.css":   "./dist/select.css",
    "./icons.css":    "./dist/icons.css",
    "./utilities.css":"./dist/utilities.css",
    "./package.json": "./package.json"
  }
  ```
  Key point for CDN: the wildcard `"./*.css": "./dist/*.css"` means **any** file in `dist/` is importable by name — including every per-component file. So `@pantoken/components/button.css` resolves to `dist/button.css`. The explicit entries (base, components, fonts, prose, select, icons, utilities) are redundant with the wildcard but hand-listed so they survive and are documented as the stable public surface.
- The `"."` root export is a **JS module** (`dist/index.mjs`), not CSS. It exports builder functions (`componentsCss`, `proseCss`, `buttonCss`, `baseCss`, etc.) that generate CSS strings at runtime with a configurable class prefix/scope. It is not a CSS entry.

### 2. CSS output layout on disk (`formats/components/dist/`)

It is **both** — a big barrel plus per-component files. There are 61 `.css` files. Naming is flat, kebab-case, one file per component/aggregate, no subdirectories:

- **Aggregate/named sheets** (the documented public surface): `base.css`, `components.css`, `prose.css`, `utilities.css`, `fonts.css`, `select.css`, `icons.css`.
- **Per-component sheets**: `alert.css`, `avatar.css`, `badge.css`, `billboard.css`, `breadcrumb.css`, `button.css`, `checkbox.css`, `modal.css`, `table.css`, `tabs.css`, `tooltip.css`, `tray.css`, `tree-browser.css`, etc. — roughly 46 of these.

`generated/` (repo-only, gitignored intermediate) mirrors the same file set; `dist/` is the packed/minified published copy. A CDN pulling from npm (jsDelivr/unpkg) serves `dist/`.

### 3. Per-component isolation and interdependencies

- Individual component CSS **can** be imported on its own. `dist/button.css` (11,347 bytes) exists as a standalone file separate from the `components.css` barrel, and the `./*.css` export makes `@pantoken/components/button.css` a valid specifier.
- Each per-component file is self-contained CSS for that component's classes (e.g. `button.css` contains only `.instui-button` rules and its modifiers). It does **not** inline a reset or token definitions.
- **Interdependency model — via CSS custom properties, not via imported CSS**: every component references `var(--instui-*)` tokens (colors, spacing, fonts, component tokens). Those token values are NOT defined inside the component files. They come from the external `@pantoken/tokens` package's token sheet, which the consumer must load separately. So a lone `button.css` renders correctly only if the `--instui-*` token variables are present on the page.
- **`base.css` is opt-in and separate** — it holds the global reset (`box-sizing`, body/html defaults, `color-scheme`) plus the `:focus-visible` focus-outline ring. Components do NOT bundle it. I confirmed `components.css` contains zero `:where(html)` base-reset markers (the `box-sizing` hits inside `components.css` are per-component local rules like the tabs panel, not the global reset). So base/reset is a peer opt-in layer, not a hard dependency baked into each component.
- **Elevation shadow scale** (`--instui-elevation-*`) is the exception: it's defined at the top of `components.css` (the `:root{...}` block). It leads the barrel so shadows are intrinsic. Individual component files that use elevation reference those custom properties (defined in the barrel), so a standalone component file that uses a shadow would need the elevation vars too. `elevationCss()` is also exposed as a builder for renderers composing their own sheets.

### 4. Build process and sizes

Build is driven by `pnpm build` → `vp pack` (vite-plus / rolldown-based). The `build` task in `formats/components/vite.config.ts` runs this pipeline:
1. `vp run @pantoken/plugin-theme-custom-media#build`
2. `node scripts/component-styles.ts` — compiles authored `src/{components,utilities,rules}/*.css` into a generated TS module of string constants (`src/generated/component-styles.ts`).
3. `node scripts/generate.ts` — emits the aggregate sheets into `generated/`: `base.css`, `components.css`, `prose.css`, `icons.css`, `utilities.css`, `fonts.css`, `select.css`.
4. `node scripts/build-entries.ts` — emits the ~46 **per-component** files into `generated/` (one file per `COMPONENTS` entry via `component.css(opts)`). This step is deliberately build-only (not part of `generate`/`docs:dev`) to avoid a hot-reload write loop.
5. `vp pack` — bundles/minifies each `generated/*.css` and `src/index.ts` into `dist/`. Config uses `css.splitting: true`, `minify: true`, `inject: false`, and `exports: false` (exports map is hand-managed).

Sizes (from `dist/`, minified):
- Full barrel **`components.css`: 144,139 bytes (~141 KB)**.
- Single component **`button.css`: 11,347 bytes (~11 KB)**; median component ~2 KB (e.g. `badge.css` 2,483; `truncate.css` just 367 bytes).
- Largest files overall: `icons.css` 225,775 bytes (~220 KB, separate by design) and `utilities.css` 28,885 bytes (~28 KB).
- All 61 CSS files combined: ~554 KB. The JS module `index.mjs` is ~656 KB (builder source, not CSS).

So for a CDN, pointing at `components.css` is ~141 KB; a targeted single-component URL (e.g. `button.css`) is roughly 1–11 KB, an order of magnitude smaller.

### 5. "Meta"/barrel CSS entry

Yes — **`components.css` is the barrel**. `generate.ts` builds it from `componentsCss(opts)`, which bundles every class-based component into one sheet (led by the `--instui-elevation-*` `:root` block). It's the documented "import everything" entry: `@pantoken/components/components.css`. There is no separate `index.css`; the root `"."`/`index` entry is JS (`index.mjs`), not a CSS barrel. The other aggregates (`utilities.css`, `icons.css`, `prose.css`) are themselves category-level barrels but are kept separate from `components.css` by design (opt-in layers). There is no single mega-file that concatenates base + components + utilities + icons + prose together; consumers compose those layers via multiple imports.

### CDN implications (summary)
A CDN URL can point at any of:
- The full barrel: `.../dist/components.css` (~141 KB) — needs external `@pantoken/tokens` vars.
- A single component: `.../dist/button.css` (~11 KB) via the `./*.css` wildcard export — needs both the token vars and, if it uses shadows, the elevation `:root` block that currently lives only in the barrel.
- Opt-in layers: `base.css`, `utilities.css`, `fonts.css`, `prose.css`, `select.css`, `icons.css`.

Notable gap for per-component CDN delivery: standalone component files assume `--instui-*` tokens (external, from `@pantoken/tokens`) and, for shadow-using components, the elevation vars defined in `components.css` — so a per-component CDN URL is not fully self-sufficient without also loading the token sheet (and possibly elevation).

Key files for reference: `formats/components/package.json`, `formats/components/vite.config.ts`, `formats/components/scripts/generate.ts`, `formats/components/scripts/build-entries.ts`, `formats/components/scripts/component-styles.ts`, `formats/components/README.md`, and the output dirs `formats/components/dist/` and `formats/components/generated/`.</result>

- CSS files emitted to `dist/` are per-record co-located reset/gate sheets plus an aggregate: `dist/components.css` (aggregate) and per-element files like `dist/tooltip.css`, `dist/calendar.css`, `dist/date-input.css`, `dist/drawer-layout.css`, `dist/pages.css`, `dist/drilldown.css`, `dist/date-time-input.css`, `dist/popover-reset.css`. Naming = `<record>.css`, matched by the `./*.css` export.

### 3. Consumer registration
Public API lives in `/Users/dwahl/Scripts/pantoken/renderers/web-components/src/index.ts`.

- **`register(target?, options?)`** — `target` defaults to `globalThis.customElements`; no-op when there's no DOM (SSR-safe). `options.prefix` sets the tag prefix, mirroring the CSS layer. A hyphen is required for custom elements, so an empty/nullish prefix falls back to `DEFAULT_PREFIX = "instui"` → `<instui-button>`; `{ prefix: "x" }` → `<x-button>`.
- **Auto-registration**: the module calls `register()` at the bottom (line 409 in src, `register();` in dist), so a bare `import "@pantoken/web-components"` registers everything in the browser automatically.

The live shadow-CSS path is the `?inline` imports plus the `@pantoken/components` `*Css()` functions.

### 5. Browser-ready standalone vs bundler-only
**Bundler/ESM-only. There is no drop-in `<script src>` build.**

- The only JS artifact is `dist/index.mjs`, an ESM module with two unresolved bare specifiers (`@pantoken/components`, `@pantoken/icons`). A plain `<script type="module" src="…/index.mjs">` from a CDN will fail unless those bare imports are resolved — via an import map, or via an ESM CDN that rewrites specifiers (e.g. `https://esm.sh/@pantoken/web-components` or `.../@pantoken/web-components/+esm` on jsDelivr, which would also pull `@pantoken/components` and `@pantoken/icons`).
- No IIFE/UMD/global-name output and no dedicated "register" bundle exist to point a classic CDN `<script>` at.
- Even via an ESM CDN, the runtime still needs a token sheet (`@pantoken/css`) loaded in the document for colors/spacing to resolve; the component look CSS and icon SVGs travel inside the JS (icon glyphs come from `@pantoken/icons` `resolve`).

The mechanism you're describing — one URL that pulls an incremental subset — exists as **jsDelivr's `/combine/` endpoint**. Comma-separate the files and it returns them as a single response:

```css
@import url("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/combine/npm/@pantoken/components@0.1/base.css,npm/@pantoken/components@0.1/button.css,npm/@pantoken/components@0.1/badge.css");
```

Two real caveats for pantoken:
- **A lone component file isn't self-sufficient.** Components reference `--instui-*` custom properties that live in the external token sheet (`@pantoken/tokens`/`@pantoken/css`), and shadow-using components need the elevation `:root` block — which today lives *only* inside the big `components.css` barrel. So true per-component delivery needs a small `foundation.css` (elevation + focus-visible) extracted out. That's a minor, well-scoped build change.
- **jsDelivr combine has documented trouble with relative `url()`** (fonts/images) and CSS content-type. Your component CSS is token-var-based (no `url()`), so it's fine — but `fonts.css` points at woff2 files and must stay a separate normal `<link>`, not go through combine. (`icons.css` needs a quick check for whether it's data-URIs vs. url refs.)

A literal `?components=button,card` query param isn't native to jsDelivr or unpkg — the comma-path combine URL is the closest off-the-shelf equivalent. A true query builder would mean running your own edge worker.

## Web components — all-or-nothing today, cherry-picking needs API work

Different story. `@pantoken/web-components` is **ESM-only** (`dist/index.mjs`), auto-registers all 30 elements on import, and has no IIFE/UMD `<script>` build. So:
- **What works now:** an ESM CDN import — `import "https://esm.sh/@pantoken/web-components"` (or jsDelivr `/+esm`) — which rewrites the bare `@pantoken/components`/`@pantoken/icons` deps and registers everything. Still needs a token sheet in the page.
- **Cherry-picking (esm.sh `?exports=`) won't work** as-is: registration goes through one shared `RegisterContext`, and there's load-order coupling (`date-time-input` → `date-input` → `calendar`). - **No classic `<script src>` global drop-in** exists; producing one means adding a UMD/IIFE build target.

input.content:
# CDN distribution for pantoken CSS and web components

## Context

pantoken already emits small, individually-publishable packages, but there's no documented CDN story
for consumers who want the Bootstrap-style "drop in a URL" experience. Two asks:

1. **CSS** — the full `components.css` barrel is ~141 KB. Consumers want to pull an *incremental* subset
   (e.g. just `button` + `badge`) through a single URL, ideally via `@import`.
2. **Web components** — same idea, plus a classic `<script src>` drop-in and true per-component
   cherry-picking.

### What's already true (verified)

- `@pantoken/components` ships ~46 per-component files (`button.css` ~11 KB, most ~2 KB) plus aggregate
  sheets, all addressable via the `"./*.css"` wildcard export. Component CSS uses only inline
  `data:image/svg+xml` URIs — **combine-safe**. `icons.css` has no `url()` — combine-safe.
- The `@pantoken/css` token sheet (`formats/css/dist/style.css`) also uses only `data:` URIs —
  combine-safe.
- `fonts.css` references **relative** `../assets/fonts/…` paths — **NOT combine-safe**; must always load
  as a plain `<link>` at its canonical package URL so the relative path resolves.
- A lone component file needs two things present on the page: the `--instui-*` token custom properties
  (from `@pantoken/css`) and, for shadow/elevation-using components, the elevation + focus `:root` block —

since instui is opinionated, should foundation.css actually be rolled into base.css and base not be marked as optional, but as required?

Good question, and I'd push back on merging them — they're different *kinds* of things, and the difference is exactly what makes cherry-picking safe.

Here's the distinction:

- **`foundation.css`** is inert: it's just `:root { --instui-elevation-*; --instui-focus-outline-* }`. It defines variables. It changes nothing on the page until a `.instui-*` component references them. Zero risk to a host document.
- **`base.css`** is invasive: it's a global reset — `box-sizing: border-box` on `*`, `html`/`body` defaults, `color-scheme` on `:root`, the `:focus-visible` ring rule. It reaches *outside* the `.instui-*` namespace and mutates the consumer's existing page.

A component's CSS depends on the *variables*, not on the *reset*. `button.css` renders correctly with `tokens + foundation`, with or without base. That's the whole reason to split them.

On "InstUI is opinionated" — it's opinionated about how *its own components* look, not about rewriting the host document. Everything else is namespaced (`--instui-*` vars, `.instui-*` classes); the reset is the one piece that escapes that namespace. So being opinionated is an argument for making components *self-sufficient in their variable deps* (= foundation, always included), not for forcing a page-wide reset on everyone.

## 1. How `formats/css/dist/style.css` and `generated/style.css` are built

Two-stage pipeline, defined in `formats/css/vite.config.ts` (build task = `["vp run generate", "vp pack"]`):

- **Stage 1 — `generated/style.css`**: `formats/css/scripts/generate.ts` imports the `css` string from `formats/css/src/index.ts` and writes it to `../generated/style.css`. That's the full, human-readable 17,043-line sheet.
- **Stage 2 — `dist/style.css`**: `vp pack` (vite-plus) takes `generated/style.css` as an entry (`style: "generated/style.css"` in the pack config) and emits a **minified single-line** `dist/style.css` (`css.minify: true`).

The `:root` content is produced entirely by `src/index.ts` → `src/to-css.ts`:

```
// formats/css/src/index.ts
import { tokens } from "@pantoken/tokens";
export const css: string = toCss(tokens);
```

`toCss(tokens, options)` (`src/to-css.ts`) consumes **only** the `@pantoken/tokens` IR array. The default `css` export passes **no plugins and no extra options**, so nothing else contributes to the shipped sheet. (`toCss` does support a `plugins` param with a `css` hook that can `prepend`/`append`/add `properties`/`declarations`, but the default stylesheet uses none.)

## 2. Dependency graph / layering

`formats/css/package.json` `dependencies`:
- `@pantoken/model`
- `@pantoken/plugin-kit`
- `@pantoken/tokens`

It does **not** depend on `@pantoken/components`, and `@pantoken/components` (`formats/components/package.json`) does **not** depend on `@pantoken/css` either. Components' deps are `@pantoken/plugin-colors` (runtime) plus dev deps `@pantoken/tokens`, `@pantoken/icons`, `@pantoken/plugin-theme-custom-media`, `@pantoken/utils`.

**Layering: `@pantoken/css` is BELOW `@pantoken/components`.** Both sit on top of `@pantoken/tokens`, but components is the higher-level consumer that builds semantic composites (elevation, focus ring) on top of the raw token vars. So having css import from components would be an **upward/inverted dependency** — not allowed by the current direction.

## 3. Where the `:root` custom properties come from

Emitted **one-per-token** from the `tokens` array, via a general pass in `src/to-css.ts` (lines 71-74):

```
for (const token of tokens) {
  if (isContextual(token.value)) declarations.push([token.name, token.value]); // var()/light-dark() → :root {}
  else properties.push({ name, syntax, value });                              // concrete → @property
}
```

It is **not curated** — every token in the IR becomes either an `@property` registration (concrete values) or a `:root` declaration (values containing `var(` or `light-dark(`). So the two ways to add new `--instui-*` props to the sheet are: (a) add them to the IR so this pass emits them, or (b) pass a plugin with a `css` hook that appends `properties`/`declarations`.

- `--instui-color-drop-shadow-shadow-color1`, `--instui-color-drop-shadow-shadow-color2`

# CDN distribution for pantoken CSS and web components

## Context

pantoken already emits small, individually-publishable packages, but there's no documented CDN story
for consumers who want the Bootstrap-style "drop in a URL" experience. Two asks:

1. **CSS** — the full `components.css` barrel is ~141 KB. Consumers want to pull an *incremental* subset
   (e.g. just `button` + `badge`) through a single URL, ideally via `@import`/`<link>`, with an
   interactive picker in the docs that builds the URL.
2. **Web components** — same idea, plus a classic `<script src>` drop-in and true per-component
   cherry-picking.

### What's already true (verified)

- `@pantoken/components` ships ~46 per-component files (`button.css` ~11 KB, most ~2 KB) plus aggregate
  sheets, all addressable via the `"./*.css"` wildcard export. Component CSS + `icons.css` + the
  `@pantoken/css` token sheet use only inline `data:` URIs — **combine-safe**. `fonts.css` uses
  **relative** `../assets/fonts/…` paths — **NOT combine-safe**; always a plain `<link>`.
- A lone component file needs the `--instui-*` token custom properties on the page. Today it *also*
  needs the elevation + focus-outline `:root` vars, which live only in `@pantoken/components`
  (`components.css` barrel + `base.css`), NOT in the token sheet — the gap this plan closes.
- `@pantoken/css` sits **below** `@pantoken/components`; it builds `dist/style.css` by running
  `toCss(tokens)` over the `@pantoken/tokens` IR (one `:root` declaration per token). It depends on
  `@pantoken/model`, `@pantoken/plugin-kit`, `@pantoken/tokens`.
- Elevation/focus values aren't in the IR — they're bespoke TS composites in
  `formats/components/src/declarations/{elevation,focus}.ts`, referencing ingredient tokens
  (`--instui-color-drop-shadow-*`, `--instui-component-shared-tokens-focus-outline-*`,
  `--instui-border-radius-md`) that already ship in the token sheet.
- `@pantoken/web-components` is ESM-only, auto-registers all 30 elements, injects a `foundationCss()`
  `:root` block (elevation+focus) precisely because the token sheet lacks them, and has no IIFE build.
  `ElementDefinition` carries `.name`; `DEFINITIONS` is in canonical, load-bearing order
  (`date-time-input` → `date-input` → `calendar`).
- The docs VitePress site registers one global custom component today (`vitepress-mermaid`) via
  `enhanceApp`, keeps UI strings in `docs/.vitepress/i18n.ts`, and hardcodes nav/sidebar per-locale in
  `docs/.vitepress/config.ts`. The canonical component list is `COMPONENTS` in
  `formats/components/src/components/index.ts` (filter `kind === "component"`); the per-component CSS
  filename equals `component.name`.

### Decisions taken (with the user)

- **CSS: option 3** — move elevation + focus-outline vars into the token sheet so any single component +
  the token sheet is self-sufficient. **`foundation.css` is not created.** `base.css` stays an opt-in
  reset (it's page-invasive — `box-sizing`, `color-scheme`; forcing it would regress embedding into an
  existing app). Recommended shared home for the moved builders: **`@pantoken/tokens`** (see A1).
- **Web components: all three tracks** — document ESM CDN, add an IIFE `<script>` build, add a
  per-component register API.
- **Docs: an interactive `<CdnPicker />`** Vue component that builds the combine URL from checkboxes.

---

## Part A — Move elevation + focus-outline into the token sheet

Chosen depth: **light** — relocate the two pure `[name,value][]` builders down one layer and emit them
from `@pantoken/css`; leave the cssdoc `@declaration` records in `@pantoken/components`. (The "deep"
alternative — modeling elevation/focus as first-class IR `Token`s — is a larger model change; note it
as a possible future, don't do it now.)

### A1. Relocate the pure builders to `@pantoken/tokens`

Move `elevationDeclarations`, `focusOutlineDeclarations`, `focusOutlineRules`, `FOCUSABLE_SELECTOR`, and
their constants (`ELEVATION_GEOMETRY`, `ELEVATION_ALIASES`, `ELEVATION_NAMES`) out of
`formats/components/src/declarations/{elevation,focus}.ts` into `@pantoken/tokens`
(`formats/tokens/src/…`, e.g. a new `declarations.ts`).

- **Why `@pantoken/tokens`:** it's the one package both consumers already share — `@pantoken/css`
  depends on it at runtime (no new dep), `@pantoken/components` has it as a devDep. Both sit above it, so
  no upward/cyclic dependency. Tradeoff: `tokens` currently ships pure IR data; this adds a small
  CSS-value-builder surface to it. (Alternative: `@pantoken/utils` — natural home for pure functions,
  but `@pantoken/css` would have to promote `utils` from devDep to a runtime dep. I recommend `tokens`.)
- Keep the builders pure — `[name, value][]` returning; no cssdoc/`Definition` concerns move.

### A2. Emit them from `@pantoken/css`

In `formats/css/src/index.ts`, have the shipped `css` string include an elevation + focus-outline
foundation block. Prefer the existing extension seam: `toCss` accepts a `plugins` param whose `css` hook
can `append` declarations (`formats/css/src/to-css.ts`), or add a foundation `sections[]` entry in
`buildCssFile`. The builders' output is contextual (`var(...)`), so `isContextual()` routes it to plain
`:root` declarations, not `@property` registrations. Net: `dist/style.css` gains `--instui-elevation-*`
(8) and `--instui-focus-outline-*` (11) at `:root`.

### A3. Stop double-emitting in `@pantoken/components`

- `formats/components/src/index.ts` — `componentsCss()` currently leads with `elevationCss()`; drop that
  lead block (the token sheet now owns it). Components keep *referencing* `var(--instui-elevation-*)`.
- `baseCss()` currently appends `focusOutlineCss()`, which emits **both** the `--instui-focus-outline-*`
  defs **and** the `:focus-visible` ring rules. Change it to append **`focusOutlineRules()` only** — the
  ring behavior stays; the var defs are now in the token sheet.
- Re-export the moved builders from `@pantoken/components` (`elevationDeclarations`, `ELEVATION_NAMES`,
  `focusOutlineDeclarations`, `focusOutlineRules`, `FOCUSABLE_SELECTOR`) so existing importers and the
  public-surface test keep working. `elevationCss()`/`focusOutlineCss()` (the doc-wrapped builders) and
  the cssdoc `elevation`/`focus` `Definition`s stay here, importing the moved pure builders.

### A4. Retire the web-components foundation injection

In `renderers/web-components/src/index.ts`: remove `foundationCss()` and the `<style
id="pantoken-foundation">` injection in `register()` — redundant now that the required token sheet
carries elevation/focus. Update the module JSDoc (it currently explains the injection) and drop the
`foundationCss` export. (`@pantoken/web-components` is `0.1.1`/@alpha, so removing the export is fine.)
The token-sheet requirement is unchanged — consumers already must load `@pantoken/css`.

### A5. Keep the other consumers working

- `renderers/pendo/src/build.ts` builds a self-contained guide sheet (no external token sheet), so it
  still emits these itself — it imports `elevationCss`/`focusOutlineRules`/`focusOutlineDeclarations`,
  which remain importable from `@pantoken/components` via the re-exports. No change needed.
- `docs/scripts/stage-component-assets.ts` imports `focusOutlineCss` (stays in components) — unaffected.
- `formats/components/scripts/generate.ts` imports `ELEVATION_NAMES` (re-exported) — unaffected.

### A6. Tests

- `formats/components/tests/sheets.test.ts` — update: `components.css` no longer leads with the elevation
  `:root` block; `base.css` no longer defines `--instui-focus-outline-*` (only the ring rules).
- Add/adjust the IR-drift check so `@pantoken/css` **expects** `--instui-elevation-*` /
  `--instui-focus-outline-*` (they're intentional now, not drift).
- Add a `@pantoken/css` test asserting `dist/style.css` contains the elevation + focus-outline vars.
- `formats/components/tests/public-surface.test.ts` passes via the re-exports.

**Result:** per-component CDN delivery = token sheet + component file, fully self-sufficient. Combine URL:

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/combine/npm/@pantoken/css@0/style.css,npm/@pantoken/components@0/button.css,npm/@pantoken/components@0/badge.css">
```

`base.css` (reset) is an optional extra file; `fonts.css` always a separate plain `<link>`.

---

## Part B — Web components

### B1. Document the ESM CDN path (works today, no code)
`<script type="module">import "https://esm.sh/@pantoken/web-components";</script>` auto-registers all
elements (CDN rewrites the bare deps); still needs the token-sheet `<link>`.

### B2. Add an IIFE/UMD `<script>` build
Add `renderers/web-components/scripts/build-iife.ts` — a direct-`node` script (per the vp-nested-spawn
constraint, call Vite's `build()` API directly; do not shell out to `vp`/`pnpm`) emitting
`dist/web-components.iife.js`: format `iife`, a global (`PantokenWebComponents` exposing `register`),
**no** externals so `@pantoken/components`/`@pantoken/icons` are inlined; the bottom-of-file
`register()` auto-registers at load. Wire it into the `build` task in
`renderers/web-components/vite.config.ts` after `vp pack`. During implementation, first check whether
`vp pack` can emit `iife` + `globalName` directly (prefer a pack entry if so; the script is the
fallback).

### B3. Per-component register API
In `renderers/web-components/src/index.ts`, extend `register(target, options)` with `only?: readonly
string[]` (base names). Build the shared `ctx` as today, then define only the requested set: iterate
`DEFINITIONS` in its existing canonical order, skipping any whose `def.name` isn't in the expanded set.
Add a `NESTED_DEPS` map so a composite pulls its children (`date-time-input` → `date-input` →
`calendar`); derive/verify the full map by auditing which `src/elements/*.ts` render functions emit
nested `tag(...)` elements before finalizing. Keep the bottom-of-file all-elements `register()` as the
default (back-compat; `only` is purely additive). Note `esm.sh?exports=` alone can't cherry-pick because
registration is a runtime side effect, not tree-shakeable exports.

---

## Part C — Docs: CDN guide + interactive `<CdnPicker />`

### C1. The picker component
`docs/.vitepress/theme/components/CdnPicker.vue` — Vue 3 `<script setup lang="ts">`, Composition API,
`<style scoped>` keyed to `--vp-*` tokens (match `ThemeSelector.vue`). Name must not start with
`instui-` (the config treats `instui-*` as custom elements).

- **Behavior:** checkbox list of components → live-builds a jsDelivr combine URL:
  base `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/combine/` + `npm/@pantoken/css@<v>/style.css` + one
  `npm/@pantoken/components@<v>/<name>.css` per checked box. Toggles: `<link>` vs `@import` output form;
  optional `base.css` (reset) checkbox; a note that fonts load separately. A "Copy" button.
- **Optional second mode (ties to B3):** a web-components tab that emits a `register(customElements, {
  only: [...] })` snippet + import-map for the checked elements. Include if low-cost; the CSS combine URL
  is the primary deliverable.
- **Component list — do not hardcode.** Add a `docs/scripts/*.ts` node script that imports `COMPONENTS`
  from `formats/components/src/components/index.ts`, filters `kind === "component"`, maps to `.name`, and
  also captures the current `@pantoken/components`/`@pantoken/css` versions, writing a small generated
  manifest under `docs/.vitepress/theme/generated/` (mirroring how other generated docs artifacts are
  produced). The picker imports that manifest. Wire the script into the docs generate step.
- **i18n:** route the picker's UI labels (headings, "Copy URL", toggle labels) through
  `docs/.vitepress/i18n.ts` + `themeConfig`, read via `useData().theme` with English defaults — the
  `ThemeSelector`/`themeSelector` precedent. Component names themselves aren't translated.

### C2. Registration + guide page
- Register `<CdnPicker />` globally in `docs/.vitepress/theme/index.ts` `enhanceApp` (like
  `vitepress-mermaid`) so it's usable in markdown.
- New guide `docs/guide/cdn.md` (+ mirrored `docs/hu/guide/cdn.md`; parity enforced by
  `docs/scripts/check-locale-parity.ts`) embedding `<CdnPicker />` and documenting: cherry-pick combine,
  the full barrel, fonts-as-separate-`<link>`, ordering (token sheet → optional base → components), the
  ESM web-components import, the IIFE `<script>`, and the per-component `register({ only })` snippet.
  State the non-goal: a literal `?components=…` query param isn't an off-the-shelf CDN feature (combine
  is the closest; a true query builder would be a separate edge-worker project).
- Add the sidebar label key to both locale blocks in `i18n.ts` and a sidebar entry (Guides group) in
  `config.ts`. Add a short pointer from `README.md`.

---

## Files to modify (representative)

- **Move down:** `formats/tokens/src/declarations.ts` (new) ← from
  `formats/components/src/declarations/{elevation,focus}.ts`; update `formats/tokens/src/index.ts` exports.
- **Emit:** `formats/css/src/index.ts` (+ maybe `formats/css/src/to-css.ts`).
- **De-dupe + re-export:** `formats/components/src/index.ts`,
  `formats/components/src/declarations/{elevation,focus,index}.ts`.
- **Web components:** `renderers/web-components/src/index.ts` (remove foundation inject; add `only`),
  `renderers/web-components/scripts/build-iife.ts` (new) + `renderers/web-components/vite.config.ts`.
- **Docs:** `docs/.vitepress/theme/components/CdnPicker.vue` (new), `docs/.vitepress/theme/index.ts`,

  edge-worker project.

## Part A — Move elevation + focus-outline into the token sheet

Chosen depth: **light** — relocate the two pure `[name,value][]` builders down one layer and emit them
from `@pantoken/css`; leave the cssdoc `@declaration` records in `@pantoken/components`. (The "deep"
alternative — modeling elevation/focus as first-class IR `Token`s — is a larger model change; note it
as a possible future, don't do it now.)

### A1. Relocate the pure builders to `@pantoken/tokens`

Move `elevationDeclarations`, `focusOutlineDeclarations`, `focusOutlineRules`, `FOCUSABLE_SELECTOR`, and
their constants (`ELEVATION_GEOMETRY`, `ELEVATION_ALIASES`, `ELEVATION_NAMES`) out of
`formats/components/src/declarations/{elevation,focus}.ts` into `@pantoken/tokens`
(`formats/tokens/src/…`, e.g. a new `declarations.ts`).

- **Why `@pantoken/tokens`:** it's the one package both consumers already share — `@pantoken/css`
  depends on it at runtime (no new dep), `@pantoken/components` has it as a devDep. Both sit above it, so
  no upward/cyclic dependency. Tradeoff: `tokens` currently ships pure IR data; this adds a small
  CSS-value-builder surface to it. (Alternative: `@pantoken/utils` — natural home for pure functions,
  but `@pantoken/css` would have to promote `utils` from devDep to a runtime dep. I recommend `tokens`.)
- Keep the builders pure — `[name, value][]` returning; no cssdoc/`Definition` concerns move.

### A2. Emit them from `@pantoken/css`

In `formats/css/src/index.ts`, have the shipped `css` string include an elevation + focus-outline
foundation block. Prefer the existing extension seam: `toCss` accepts a `plugins` param whose `css` hook
can `append` declarations (`formats/css/src/to-css.ts`), or add a foundation `sections[]` entry in
`buildCssFile`. The builders' output is contextual (`var(...)`), so `isContextual()` routes it to plain
`:root` declarations, not `@property` registrations. Net: `dist/style.css` gains `--instui-elevation-*`
(8) and `--instui-focus-outline-*` (11) at `:root`.

### A3. Stop double-emitting in `@pantoken/components`

  public-surface test keep working. `elevationCss()`/`focusOutlineCss()` (the doc-wrapped builders) and
  the cssdoc `elevation`/`focus` `Definition`s stay here, importing the moved pure builders.

### A4. Retire the web-components foundation injection

In `renderers/web-components/src/index.ts`: remove `foundationCss()` and the `<style
id="pantoken-foundation">` injection in `register()` — redundant now that the required token sheet
carries elevation/focus. Update the module JSDoc (it currently explains the injection) and drop the
`foundationCss` export. (`@pantoken/web-components` is `0.1.1`/@alpha, so removing the export is fine.)
The token-sheet requirement is unchanged — consumers already must load `@pantoken/css`.

### A5. Keep the other consumers working

content.text:
Now I can answer your question honestly, with numbers.

**Is the foundation really 1.6 MB?** No — that's the *uncompressed* file, and no CDN serves uncompressed. Over the wire it's **137 KB gzip / 107 KB brotli**. But you're still right to be skeptical: 137 KB of mandatory foundation to render a 2 KB button is a bad ratio, and it *does* make the modularization mostly theater.

**Why it's that big:** 86% of the token sheet (1.36 MB raw) is `@property` registration blocks — 2,487 of them, each ~110 bytes of `syntax`/`inherits`/`initial-value` boilerplate. Only 13% is the actual `:root`/`light-dark()` declarations components read through `var()`.

**The lever:** every one of those `@property` blocks carries a recoverable `initial-value`, so a **declarations-only "lean" token sheet** — emit concrete tokens as plain `:root { --x: value }` instead of typed `@property` blocks — is clean to produce and lands around **~25–35 KB gzip** (measured ~24 KB capturing most of them; the real build will be in that band). That's ~5x smaller, and puts "foundation + one button" at roughly the size of *all* of Bootstrap's CSS. At that point modularization actually pays off.

**What you'd give up in lean mode:** typed custom properties — `syntax` validation, guaranteed `initial-value` fallbacks when a var is unset, and the ability to *animate the custom properties themselves*. For static component rendering that's almost never load-bearing, but it needs verifying (e.g. any theme-switch crossfade or `transition` on an `--instui-*` property). The full typed sheet stays the default for app/bundler consumers; the lean one is the CDN/embed foundation.

So my honest verdict: **the CDN work is worth doing only if a lean token sheet comes with it.** Without that, don't bother with per-component cherry-picking — just document the barrel and the full sheet and move on, because the foundation dominates. The lean sheet is the keystone, and it's a modest change (`@pantoken/css` already routes everything through `toCss(tokens)`; add a declarations-only mode/entry).

# CDN distribution for pantoken CSS and web components

## Context

pantoken already emits small, individually-publishable packages, but there's no documented CDN story
for the Bootstrap-style "drop in a URL" experience, and per-component modularization is undercut by the
size of the mandatory token foundation. Two asks:

1. **CSS** — pull an *incremental* subset of components through a single URL (via `@import`/`<link>`),
   with an interactive docs picker that builds the URL — *and* make it actually pay off by shrinking the
   token foundation you must load alongside it.
2. **Web components** — same idea, plus a classic `<script src>` drop-in and true per-component
   cherry-picking.

### What's already true (verified)

- **The token foundation is the real bottleneck.** `@pantoken/css` `dist/style.css` is 1.5 MB raw but
  **137 KB gzip / 107 KB brotli** over the wire (no CDN serves uncompressed). **86% of it (1.36 MB raw)
  is 2,487 `@property` registration blocks**; only 13% is the `:root`/`light-dark()` declarations
  components read via `var()`. Every `@property` block carries a recoverable `initial-value`, so a
  declarations-only "lean" sheet is clean to produce and measures **~25–35 KB gzip** (~5x smaller).
- `toCss(tokens)` (`formats/css/src/to-css.ts`) already splits tokens: **concrete → `@property`**
  (`properties[]`), **contextual (`var()`/`light-dark()`) → `:root` declaration** (`declarations[]` via
  `isContextual`). It takes a `ToCssOptions` ({ scope, plugins }) and composes via `buildCssFile`.
  `formats/css/src/index.ts` exports `css = toCss(tokens)`.
- `@pantoken/components` ships ~46 per-component files (`button.css` ~11 KB, most ~2 KB) plus aggregate
  sheets, all addressable via `"./*.css"`. Component CSS + `icons.css` + the token sheet use only inline
  `data:` URIs — **combine-safe**. `fonts.css` uses relative `../assets/fonts/…` — **NOT** combine-safe.
- A lone component needs the `--instui-*` tokens on the page, plus elevation + focus-outline `:root`
  vars — which today live only in `@pantoken/components` (`components.css` barrel + `base.css`), NOT in
  the token sheet. Those are bespoke TS composites in `formats/components/src/declarations/{elevation,
  focus}.ts`, referencing ingredient tokens that already ship in the token sheet.
- `@pantoken/css` sits **below** `@pantoken/components`; deps `@pantoken/model`, `@pantoken/plugin-kit`,
  `@pantoken/tokens`. Both packages share `@pantoken/tokens`.
- `@pantoken/web-components` is ESM-only, auto-registers all 30 elements, injects a `foundationCss()`
  `:root` block precisely because the token sheet lacks elevation/focus, and has no IIFE build.
  `ElementDefinition` carries `.name`; `DEFINITIONS` is load-bearing order (`date-time-input` →
  `date-input` → `calendar`).
- The docs VitePress site registers one global component (`vitepress-mermaid`) via `enhanceApp`, keeps
  UI strings in `docs/.vitepress/i18n.ts`, hardcodes nav/sidebar per-locale in `config.ts`. Canonical
  component list is `COMPONENTS` in `formats/components/src/components/index.ts` (filter `kind ===
  "component"`); per-component CSS filename = `component.name`.

### Decisions taken (with the user)

- **Keystone — lean token sheet.** Add a declarations-only token entry (~25–35 KB gzip) as the CDN/embed
  foundation; keep the full typed `style.css` as the default for bundler/app consumers. Without this the
  CDN work isn't worth doing; with it, "foundation + one button" is ~Bootstrap-sized.
- **CSS foundation — option 3.** Move elevation + focus-outline vars into the token sheet (both variants)
  so any single component + the lean sheet is self-sufficient. **No `foundation.css`.** `base.css` stays
  an opt-in reset (page-invasive `box-sizing`/`color-scheme` — forcing it would regress embedding).
- **Web components — all three tracks:** document ESM CDN, add an IIFE `<script>` build, add a
  per-component register API.
- **Docs — an interactive `<CdnPicker />`** that builds the combine URL from checkboxes.

---

## Part 0 — Lean token sheet (keystone)

Add a declarations-only variant of the token sheet so CDN consumers load ~25–35 KB gzip instead of 137.

- **`formats/css/src/to-css.ts`** — add a `typed?: boolean` option to `ToCssOptions` (default `true`,
  preserving current behavior). When `typed === false`, route **every** token to `declarations[]` (emit
  as plain `:root { --x: value }`) and pass empty `properties` to `buildCssFile` — no `@property` blocks.
  The concrete tokens' values (currently only in `@property { initial-value }`) are thereby preserved as
  ordinary declarations. Update the doc comment/marker line accordingly.
- **`formats/css/src/index.ts`** — add `export const leanCss = toCss(tokens, { typed: false });`
  alongside the existing typed `css`.
- **`formats/css/scripts/generate.ts`** — also write `generated/style.lean.css` from `leanCss` (next to
  `generated/style.css`).
- **`formats/css/vite.config.ts`** — add a pack entry for `style.lean` → `generated/style.lean.css`.
- **`formats/css/package.json`** — add `"./style.lean.css": "./dist/style.lean.css"` to `exports`.
- **Test** — assert `style.lean.css` contains no `@property`, contains representative concrete tokens as
  `:root` declarations, and is materially smaller than `style.css`.

Tradeoff (document): the lean sheet drops typed custom properties — `syntax` validation, guaranteed
`initial-value` fallbacks, and animatability of the `--instui-*` properties themselves. Verify nothing in
the component CSS `transition`s/animates a custom property directly (theme crossfades, etc.); the
`focus-outline-transition` animates `outline-*`, not the property, so it's fine.

---

## Part A — Move elevation + focus-outline into the token sheet

Chosen depth: **light** — relocate the two pure `[name,value][]` builders down one layer and emit them
from `@pantoken/css`; leave the cssdoc `@declaration` records in `@pantoken/components`. (The "deep"
alternative — first-class IR `Token`s — is a larger model change; note as future, don't do now.)

Move `elevationDeclarations`, `focusOutlineDeclarations`, `focusOutlineRules`, `FOCUSABLE_SELECTOR`, and
constants (`ELEVATION_GEOMETRY`/`ELEVATION_ALIASES`/`ELEVATION_NAMES`) from
`formats/components/src/declarations/{elevation,focus}.ts` into `@pantoken/tokens`
(`formats/tokens/src/declarations.ts`, new; export from its index). `@pantoken/css` depends on `tokens`
at runtime (no new dep); `@pantoken/components` has it as a devDep. No upward/cyclic edge. Keep them pure
(`[name,value][]`); no cssdoc/`Definition` concerns move. **Recommendation:** `@pantoken/tokens`
(zero new deps) over `@pantoken/utils` (would need promoting to a `css` runtime dep) — flagged as a
minor fork.

### A2. Emit them from `@pantoken/css` (into both sheets)
In `formats/css/src/index.ts`, feed the elevation + focus-outline declarations into `toCss` — cleanest
via a small foundation plugin (`ToCssOptions.plugins`, `css` hook `declarations`) or an extra section.
Because the values are contextual (`var(...)`), `isContextual()` routes them to `:root` declarations in
**both** the typed `css` and the lean `leanCss` builds — so both sheets carry `--instui-elevation-*` (8)
and `--instui-focus-outline-*` (11). Every ingredient token they reference already ships, so no dangling
refs.

### A3. Stop double-emitting in `@pantoken/components`
- `componentsCss()` (`formats/components/src/index.ts`) — drop the leading `elevationCss()` block (token
  sheet owns it now); components keep referencing `var(--instui-elevation-*)`.
- `baseCss()` — change the appended `focusOutlineCss()` to **`focusOutlineRules()` only** (keep the
  `:focus-visible` ring behavior; the var defs are now in the token sheet).
- Re-export the moved builders from `@pantoken/components` so existing importers + the public-surface
  test keep working; `elevationCss()`/`focusOutlineCss()` (doc-wrapped) and the cssdoc
  `elevation`/`focus` `Definition`s stay here, importing the moved pure builders.

### A4. Retire the web-components foundation injection
`renderers/web-components/src/index.ts` — remove `foundationCss()` and the `<style
id="pantoken-foundation">` injection in `register()` (redundant now the required token sheet carries
them); update the module JSDoc; drop the `foundationCss` export (`@alpha`, fine).

### A5. Keep other consumers working
`renderers/pendo/src/build.ts` (self-contained sheet) still imports `elevationCss`/`focusOutlineRules`/
`focusOutlineDeclarations` — available via the components re-exports; no change.
`docs/scripts/stage-component-assets.ts` (`focusOutlineCss`) and
`formats/components/scripts/generate.ts` (`ELEVATION_NAMES`) — unaffected via re-exports.

### A6. Tests
Update `formats/components/tests/sheets.test.ts` (`components.css` no longer leads with elevation
`:root`; `base.css` no longer defines `--instui-focus-outline-*`, only ring rules). Adjust IR-drift so
`@pantoken/css` **expects** the elevation/focus vars. Add a `@pantoken/css` test asserting both sheets
contain them. `public-surface.test.ts` passes via re-exports.

**Result — the CDN combine URL (foundation = lean sheet):**
```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/combine/npm/@pantoken/css@0/style.lean.css,npm/@pantoken/components@0/button.css,npm/@pantoken/components@0/badge.css">
```
`base.css` (reset) optional; `fonts.css` always a separate plain `<link>`.

---

## Part B — Web components

- **B1. Document ESM CDN (no code):** `<script type="module">import
  "https://esm.sh/@pantoken/web-components";</script>` auto-registers all elements; needs the token-sheet
  `<link>` (lean is fine).
- **B2. IIFE `<script>` build:** add `renderers/web-components/scripts/build-iife.ts` — a direct-`node`
  script (call Vite's `build()` API directly per the vp-nested-spawn constraint; no `vp`/`pnpm` shell-out)
  emitting `dist/web-components.iife.js`: format `iife`, global `PantokenWebComponents` (exposing
  `register`), no externals (inline `@pantoken/components`/`@pantoken/icons`); bottom-of-file `register()`
  auto-registers at load. Wire into the `build` task in `renderers/web-components/vite.config.ts` after
  `vp pack`. First check whether `vp pack` can emit `iife` + `globalName` directly (prefer that; script is
  the fallback).
- **B3. Per-component register API:** extend `register(target, options)` with `only?: readonly string[]`
  (base names). Build `ctx` as today, then iterate `DEFINITIONS` in canonical order defining only names in
  the expanded set. Add a `NESTED_DEPS` map so composites pull children (`date-time-input` → `date-input`
  → `calendar`); verify the full map by auditing which `src/elements/*.ts` render nested `tag(...)`
  elements. Keep the all-elements auto-`register()` as default (back-compat). Note `esm.sh?exports=` can't
  cherry-pick (registration is a runtime side effect, not tree-shakeable).

---

## Part C — Docs: CDN guide + interactive `<CdnPicker />`

### C1. The picker component
`docs/.vitepress/theme/components/CdnPicker.vue` — Vue 3 `<script setup lang="ts">`, `<style scoped>`
keyed to `--vp-*` (match `ThemeSelector.vue`). Name must not start with `instui-`.

  `base.css` (reset); lean vs full token sheet (default lean, with the size delta shown); a note that
  fonts load separately. A "Copy" button.

  [...] })` snippet + import-map for the checked elements — include if low-cost; CSS URL is primary.

  `formats/components/src/components/index.ts`, filters `kind === "component"`, maps to `.name`, captures

input.plan:
# CDN distribution for pantoken CSS and web components

## Context

pantoken already emits small, individually-publishable packages, but there's no documented CDN story
for the Bootstrap-style "drop in a URL" experience, and per-component modularization is undercut by the
size of the mandatory token foundation. Two asks:

1. **CSS** — pull an *incremental* subset of components through a single URL (via `@import`/`<link>`),
   with an interactive docs picker that builds the URL — *and* make it actually pay off by shrinking the
   token foundation you must load alongside it.
2. **Web components** — same idea, plus a classic `<script src>` drop-in and true per-component
   cherry-picking.

### What's already true (verified)

- **The token foundation is the real bottleneck.** `@pantoken/css` `dist/style.css` is 1.5 MB raw but
  **137 KB gzip / 107 KB brotli** over the wire (no CDN serves uncompressed). **86% of it (1.36 MB raw)
  is 2,487 `@property` registration blocks**; only 13% is the `:root`/`light-dark()` declarations
  components read via `var()`. Every `@property` block carries a recoverable `initial-value`, so a
  declarations-only "lean" sheet is clean to produce and measures **~25–35 KB gzip** (~5x smaller).
- `toCss(tokens)` (`formats/css/src/to-css.ts`) already splits tokens: **concrete → `@property`**
  (`properties[]`), **contextual (`var()`/`light-dark()`) → `:root` declaration** (`declarations[]` via
  `isContextual`). It takes a `ToCssOptions` ({ scope, plugins }) and composes via `buildCssFile`.
  `formats/css/src/index.ts` exports `css = toCss(tokens)`.
- `@pantoken/components` ships ~46 per-component files (`button.css` ~11 KB, most ~2 KB) plus aggregate
  sheets, all addressable via `"./*.css"`. Component CSS + `icons.css` + the token sheet use only inline
  `data:` URIs — **combine-safe**. `fonts.css` uses relative `../assets/fonts/…` — **NOT** combine-safe.
- A lone component needs the `--instui-*` tokens on the page, plus elevation + focus-outline `:root`
  vars — which today live only in `@pantoken/components` (`components.css` barrel + `base.css`), NOT in
  the token sheet. Those are bespoke TS composites in `formats/components/src/declarations/{elevation,
  focus}.ts`, referencing ingredient tokens that already ship in the token sheet.
- `@pantoken/css` sits **below** `@pantoken/components`; deps `@pantoken/model`, `@pantoken/plugin-kit`,
  `@pantoken/tokens`. Both packages share `@pantoken/tokens`.
- `@pantoken/web-components` is ESM-only, auto-registers all 30 elements, injects a `foundationCss()`
  `:root` block precisely because the token sheet lacks elevation/focus, and has no IIFE build.
  `ElementDefinition` carries `.name`; `DEFINITIONS` is load-bearing order (`date-time-input` →
  `date-input` → `calendar`).
- The docs VitePress site registers one global component (`vitepress-mermaid`) via `enhanceApp`, keeps
  UI strings in `docs/.vitepress/i18n.ts`, hardcodes nav/sidebar per-locale in `config.ts`. Canonical
  component list is `COMPONENTS` in `formats/components/src/components/index.ts` (filter `kind ===
  "component"`); per-component CSS filename = `component.name`.

### Decisions taken (with the user)

- **Keystone — lean token sheet.** Add a declarations-only token entry (~25–35 KB gzip) as the CDN/embed
  foundation; keep the full typed `style.css` as the default for bundler/app consumers. Without this the
  CDN work isn't worth doing; with it, "foundation + one button" is ~Bootstrap-sized.
- **CSS foundation — option 3.** Move elevation + focus-outline vars into the token sheet (both variants)
  so any single component + the lean sheet is self-sufficient. **No `foundation.css`.** `base.css` stays
  an opt-in reset (page-invasive `box-sizing`/`color-scheme` — forcing it would regress embedding).
- **Web components — all three tracks:** document ESM CDN, add an IIFE `<script>` build, add a
  per-component register API.
- **Docs — an interactive `<CdnPicker />`** that builds the combine URL from checkboxes.

---

## Part 0 — Lean token sheet (keystone)

Add a declarations-only variant of the token sheet so CDN consumers load ~25–35 KB gzip instead of 137.
Most of the weight is 1,777 `@property syntax:"<image>"` icon data-URIs (of 2,487 total) — pure ballast
in the CDN case.

**Why this is safe (verified):** no `--instui-*` token is ever animated as a custom property. Every
animation in the repo (badge pulse, focus-outline, spinner, checkbox/radio, popover/tray, img filter, …)
targets a *regular* CSS property (`opacity`, `transform`, `outline-color`, `filter`, …) that reads a
token via `var()` — interpolation happens on the CSS property, not the custom property, so it works
whether or not the token is `@property`-registered. The one directly-animated custom property (`--value`,
progress-circle) is **component-local**: its `@property` ships in `progress-circle.css`, not the token
sheet, so lean doesn't touch it. So the "keep typed" set is **empty today** — but the design stays
selective + guarded because the user wants animations preserved robustly ("there may be others").

Design it selectively, not as a blunt strip:

- **`formats/css/src/to-css.ts`** — add `lean?: boolean` (default `false`) and `keepTyped?: (name:
  string) => boolean` (default `() => false`) to `ToCssOptions`. In lean mode, route every concrete token
  to `declarations[]` (plain `:root { --x: value }`) **except** those matching `keepTyped`, which stay as
  typed `@property` registrations. The concrete values (today only in `@property { initial-value }`) are
  thereby preserved as ordinary declarations. Update the doc comment/marker.
- **Plugins in scope + latent-bug fix** — `appendContribution` currently emits plugin `c.properties` as
  `@property` blocks with a hardcoded `inherits: true` and **no `isContextual` guard** (a real bug: a
  plugin passing a `var()`/`light-dark()` initial-value emits invalid `@property`). Fix it and route it
  through the same policy: (a) always send a contextual initial-value to a declaration (guard fix,
  applies in both modes); (b) in lean mode, flatten non-`keepTyped` `c.properties` to `:root`
  declarations too. No shipped plugin sets `c.properties` and the default sheet passes no plugins, so
  this is a no-op today for our output — it's correctness + future-proofing (e.g. astro's `pantokenCss`
  forwards caller plugins).
- **`formats/css/src/index.ts`** — add `export const leanCss = toCss(tokens, { lean: true });` alongside
  the typed `css` (Part A's foundation plugin is passed to both).
- **`formats/css/scripts/generate.ts`** — also write `generated/style.lean.css` from `leanCss`.
- **`formats/css/vite.config.ts`** — add a `style.lean` pack entry → `generated/style.lean.css`.
- **`formats/css/package.json`** — add `"./style.lean.css": "./dist/style.lean.css"` to `exports`.
- **Guard test (protects "there may be others"):** a repo-level check that scans `formats/components` +
  `renderers/web-components` CSS for custom properties that are transitioned/animated directly or
  interpolated in `@keyframes`, resolves which are `--instui-*` tokens present in the token sheet, and
  fails if any such token is NOT in `keepTyped` (i.e. would be flattened). Seeds `keepTyped` from this —
  empty today, self-correcting if a future component animates a token property.
- **Lean-sheet test:** assert `style.lean.css` has zero `@property` (given empty `keepTyped`), carries
  representative concrete tokens + the elevation/focus vars as `:root` declarations, and is materially
  smaller than `style.css`.

Tradeoff (document): the lean sheet drops typed custom properties — `syntax` validation, guaranteed
`initial-value` fallbacks, and typed interpretation inside `calc()`/`conic-gradient`/color functions.
That's a *visual-parity* risk, not an animation risk — covered by the render-diff in Verification.

---

## Part A — Move elevation + focus-outline into the token sheet

Chosen depth: **light** — relocate the two pure `[name,value][]` builders down one layer and emit them
from `@pantoken/css`; leave the cssdoc `@declaration` records in `@pantoken/components`. (The "deep"
alternative — first-class IR `Token`s — is a larger model change; note as future, don't do now.)

### A1. Relocate the pure builders to `@pantoken/tokens`
Move `elevationDeclarations`, `focusOutlineDeclarations`, `focusOutlineRules`, `FOCUSABLE_SELECTOR`, and
constants (`ELEVATION_GEOMETRY`/`ELEVATION_ALIASES`/`ELEVATION_NAMES`) from
`formats/components/src/declarations/{elevation,focus}.ts` into `@pantoken/tokens`
(`formats/tokens/src/declarations.ts`, new; export from its index). `@pantoken/css` depends on `tokens`
at runtime (no new dep); `@pantoken/components` has it as a devDep. No upward/cyclic edge. Keep them pure
(`[name,value][]`); no cssdoc/`Definition` concerns move. **Recommendation:** `@pantoken/tokens`
(zero new deps) over `@pantoken/utils` (would need promoting to a `css` runtime dep) — flagged as a
minor fork.

### A2. Emit them from `@pantoken/css` (into both sheets)
In `formats/css/src/index.ts`, feed the elevation + focus-outline declarations into `toCss` — cleanest
via a small foundation plugin (`ToCssOptions.plugins`, `css` hook `declarations`) or an extra section.
Because the values are contextual (`var(...)`), `isContextual()` routes them to `:root` declarations in
**both** the typed `css` and the lean `leanCss` builds — so both sheets carry `--instui-elevation-*` (8)
and `--instui-focus-outline-*` (11). Every ingredient token they reference already ships, so no dangling
refs.

### A3. Stop double-emitting in `@pantoken/components`
- `componentsCss()` (`formats/components/src/index.ts`) — drop the leading `elevationCss()` block (token
  sheet owns it now); components keep referencing `var(--instui-elevation-*)`.
- `baseCss()` — change the appended `focusOutlineCss()` to **`focusOutlineRules()` only** (keep the
  `:focus-visible` ring behavior; the var defs are now in the token sheet).
- Re-export the moved builders from `@pantoken/components` so existing importers + the public-surface
  test keep working; `elevationCss()`/`focusOutlineCss()` (doc-wrapped) and the cssdoc
  `elevation`/`focus` `Definition`s stay here, importing the moved pure builders.

### A4. Retire the web-components foundation injection
`renderers/web-components/src/index.ts` — remove `foundationCss()` and the `<style
id="pantoken-foundation">` injection in `register()` (redundant now the required token sheet carries
them); update the module JSDoc; drop the `foundationCss` export (`@alpha`, fine).

### A5. Keep other consumers working
`renderers/pendo/src/build.ts` (self-contained sheet) still imports `elevationCss`/`focusOutlineRules`/
`focusOutlineDeclarations` — available via the components re-exports; no change.
`docs/scripts/stage-component-assets.ts` (`focusOutlineCss`) and
`formats/components/scripts/generate.ts` (`ELEVATION_NAMES`) — unaffected via re-exports.

### A6. Tests
Update `formats/components/tests/sheets.test.ts` (`components.css` no longer leads with elevation
`:root`; `base.css` no longer defines `--instui-focus-outline-*`, only ring rules). Adjust IR-drift so
`@pantoken/css` **expects** the elevation/focus vars. Add a `@pantoken/css` test asserting both sheets
contain them. `public-surface.test.ts` passes via re-exports.

**Result — the CDN combine URL (foundation = lean sheet):**
```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/combine/npm/@pantoken/css@0/style.lean.css,npm/@pantoken/components@0/button.css,npm/@pantoken/components@0/badge.css">
```
`base.css` (reset) optional; `fonts.css` always a separate plain `<link>`.

---

## Part B — Web components

- **B1. Document ESM CDN (no code):** `<script type="module">import
  "https://esm.sh/@pantoken/web-components";</script>` auto-registers all elements; needs the token-sheet
  `<link>` (lean is fine).
- **B2. IIFE `<script>` build:** add `renderers/web-components/scripts/build-iife.ts` — a direct-`node`
  script (call Vite's `build()` API directly per the vp-nested-spawn constraint; no `vp`/`pnpm` shell-out)
  emitting `dist/web-components.iife.js`: format `iife`, global `PantokenWebComponents` (exposing
  `register`), no externals (inline `@pantoken/components`/`@pantoken/icons`); bottom-of-file `register()`
  auto-registers at load. Wire into the `build` task in `renderers/web-components/vite.config.ts` after

  the fallback).

`docs/.vitepress/theme/components/CdnPicker.vue` — Vue 3 `<script setup lang="ts">`, `<style scoped>`

# CDN distribution for pantoken CSS and web components

## Context

pantoken already emits small, individually-publishable packages, but there's no documented CDN story
for the Bootstrap-style "drop in a URL" experience, and per-component modularization is undercut by the
size of the mandatory token foundation. Two asks:

1. **CSS** — pull an *incremental* subset of components through a single URL (via `@import`/`<link>`),
   with an interactive docs picker that builds the URL — *and* make it actually pay off by shrinking the
   token foundation you must load alongside it.
2. **Web components** — same idea, plus a classic `<script src>` drop-in and true per-component
   cherry-picking.

### What's already true (verified)

- **The token foundation is the real bottleneck.** `@pantoken/css` `dist/style.css` is 1.5 MB raw but
  **137 KB gzip / 107 KB brotli** over the wire (no CDN serves uncompressed). **86% of it (1.36 MB raw)
  is 2,487 `@property` registration blocks**; only 13% is the `:root`/`light-dark()` declarations
  components read via `var()`. Every `@property` block carries a recoverable `initial-value`, so a
  declarations-only "lean" sheet is clean to produce and measures **~25–35 KB gzip** (~5x smaller).
- `toCss(tokens)` (`formats/css/src/to-css.ts`) already splits tokens: **concrete → `@property`**
  (`properties[]`), **contextual (`var()`/`light-dark()`) → `:root` declaration** (`declarations[]` via
  `isContextual`). It takes a `ToCssOptions` ({ scope, plugins }) and composes via `buildCssFile`.
  `formats/css/src/index.ts` exports `css = toCss(tokens)`.
- `@pantoken/components` ships ~46 per-component files (`button.css` ~11 KB, most ~2 KB) plus aggregate
  sheets, all addressable via `"./*.css"`. Component CSS + `icons.css` + the token sheet use only inline
  `data:` URIs — **combine-safe**. `fonts.css` uses relative `../assets/fonts/…` — **NOT** combine-safe.
- A lone component needs the `--instui-*` tokens on the page, plus elevation + focus-outline `:root`
  vars — which today live only in `@pantoken/components` (`components.css` barrel + `base.css`), NOT in
  the token sheet. Those are bespoke TS composites in `formats/components/src/declarations/{elevation,
  focus}.ts`, referencing ingredient tokens that already ship in the token sheet.
- `@pantoken/css` sits **below** `@pantoken/components`; deps `@pantoken/model`, `@pantoken/plugin-kit`,
  `@pantoken/tokens`. Both packages share `@pantoken/tokens`.
- `@pantoken/web-components` is ESM-only, auto-registers all 30 elements, injects a `foundationCss()`
  `:root` block precisely because the token sheet lacks elevation/focus, and has no IIFE build.
  `ElementDefinition` carries `.name`; `DEFINITIONS` is load-bearing order (`date-time-input` →
  `date-input` → `calendar`).
- The docs VitePress site registers one global component (`vitepress-mermaid`) via `enhanceApp`, keeps
  UI strings in `docs/.vitepress/i18n.ts`, hardcodes nav/sidebar per-locale in `config.ts`. Canonical
  component list is `COMPONENTS` in `formats/components/src/components/index.ts` (filter `kind ===
  "component"`); per-component CSS filename = `component.name`.

### Decisions taken (with the user)

- **Keystone — lean token sheet.** Add a declarations-only token entry (~25–35 KB gzip) as the CDN/embed
  foundation; keep the full typed `style.css` as the default for bundler/app consumers. Without this the
  CDN work isn't worth doing; with it, "foundation + one button" is ~Bootstrap-sized.
- **CSS foundation — option 3.** Move elevation + focus-outline vars into the token sheet (both variants)
  so any single component + the lean sheet is self-sufficient. **No `foundation.css`.** `base.css` stays
  an opt-in reset (page-invasive `box-sizing`/`color-scheme` — forcing it would regress embedding).
- **Web components — all three tracks:** document ESM CDN, add an IIFE `<script>` build, add a
  per-component register API.
- **Docs — an interactive `<CdnPicker />`** that builds the combine URL from checkboxes.

---

## Part 0 — Lean token sheet (keystone)

Add a declarations-only variant of the token sheet so CDN consumers load ~25–35 KB gzip instead of 137.
Most of the weight is 1,777 `@property syntax:"<image>"` icon data-URIs (of 2,487 total) — pure ballast
in the CDN case.

**Why this is safe (verified):** no `--instui-*` token is ever animated as a custom property. Every
animation in the repo (badge pulse, focus-outline, spinner, checkbox/radio, popover/tray, img filter, …)
targets a *regular* CSS property (`opacity`, `transform`, `outline-color`, `filter`, …) that reads a
token via `var()` — interpolation happens on the CSS property, not the custom property, so it works
whether or not the token is `@property`-registered. The one directly-animated custom property (`--value`,
progress-circle) is **component-local**: its `@property` ships in `progress-circle.css`, not the token
sheet, so lean doesn't touch it. So the "keep typed" set is **empty today** — but the design stays
selective + guarded because the user wants animations preserved robustly ("there may be others").

Design it selectively, not as a blunt strip:

- **`formats/css/src/to-css.ts`** — add `lean?: boolean` (default `false`) and `keepTyped?: (name:
  string) => boolean` (default `() => false`) to `ToCssOptions`. In lean mode, route every concrete token
  to `declarations[]` (plain `:root { --x: value }`) **except** those matching `keepTyped`, which stay as
  typed `@property` registrations. The concrete values (today only in `@property { initial-value }`) are
  thereby preserved as ordinary declarations. Update the doc comment/marker.
- **Plugins in scope + latent-bug fix** — `appendContribution` currently emits plugin `c.properties` as
  `@property` blocks with a hardcoded `inherits: true` and **no `isContextual` guard** (a real bug: a
  plugin passing a `var()`/`light-dark()` initial-value emits invalid `@property`). Fix it and route it
  through the same policy: (a) always send a contextual initial-value to a declaration (guard fix,
  applies in both modes); (b) in lean mode, flatten non-`keepTyped` `c.properties` to `:root`
  declarations too. No shipped plugin sets `c.properties` and the default sheet passes no plugins, so
  this is a no-op today for our output — it's correctness + future-proofing (e.g. astro's `pantokenCss`
  forwards caller plugins).
- **`formats/css/src/index.ts`** — add `export const leanCss = toCss(tokens, { lean: true });` alongside
  the typed `css` (Part A's foundation plugin is passed to both).
- **`formats/css/scripts/generate.ts`** — also write `generated/style.lean.css` from `leanCss`.
- **`formats/css/vite.config.ts`** — add a `style.lean` pack entry → `generated/style.lean.css`.
- **`formats/css/package.json`** — add `"./style.lean.css": "./dist/style.lean.css"` to `exports`.
- **Guard test (protects "there may be others"):** a repo-level check that scans `formats/components` +
  `renderers/web-components` CSS for custom properties that are transitioned/animated directly or
  interpolated in `@keyframes`, resolves which are `--instui-*` tokens present in the token sheet, and
  fails if any such token is NOT in `keepTyped` (i.e. would be flattened). Seeds `keepTyped` from this —
  empty today, self-correcting if a future component animates a token property.
- **Lean-sheet test:** assert `style.lean.css` has zero `@property` (given empty `keepTyped`), carries
  representative concrete tokens + the elevation/focus vars as `:root` declarations, and is materially
  smaller than `style.css`.

Tradeoff (document): the lean sheet drops typed custom properties — `syntax` validation, guaranteed
`initial-value` fallbacks, and typed interpretation inside `calc()`/`conic-gradient`/color functions.
That's a *visual-parity* risk, not an animation risk — covered by the render-diff in Verification.

---

## Part A — Move elevation + focus-outline into the token sheet

Chosen depth: **light** — relocate the two pure `[name,value][]` builders down one layer and emit them
from `@pantoken/css`; leave the cssdoc `@declaration` records in `@pantoken/components`. (The "deep"
alternative — first-class IR `Token`s — is a larger model change; note as future, don't do now.)

### A1. Relocate the pure builders to `@pantoken/utils`
Move `elevationDeclarations`, `focusOutlineDeclarations`, `focusOutlineRules`, `FOCUSABLE_SELECTOR`, and
constants (`ELEVATION_GEOMETRY`/`ELEVATION_ALIASES`/`ELEVATION_NAMES`) from
`formats/components/src/declarations/{elevation,focus}.ts` into `@pantoken/utils`
(`packages/utils/src/declarations.ts`, new; re-exported from the `src/index.ts` barrel). `@pantoken/utils`
depends only on `@pantoken/model` + arkregex, so it's a safe low-level home with no cycle (`css` and
`components` both sit above it). **Promote `@pantoken/utils` from a devDependency to a runtime dependency
in `formats/css/package.json`** so `@pantoken/css` can import the builders; `@pantoken/components` keeps
it as a devDep (its CSS is emitted by build scripts). Keep the builders pure (`[name,value][]`) — no
Node imports (they're safe for the browser-facing graphs), and no cssdoc/`Definition` concerns move.

### A2. Emit them from `@pantoken/css` (into both sheets)
In `formats/css/src/index.ts`, feed the elevation + focus-outline declarations into `toCss` — cleanest
via a small foundation plugin (`ToCssOptions.plugins`, `css` hook `declarations`) or an extra section.
Because the values are contextual (`var(...)`), `isContextual()` routes them to `:root` declarations in
**both** the typed `css` and the lean `leanCss` builds — so both sheets carry `--instui-elevation-*` (8)
and `--instui-focus-outline-*` (11). Every ingredient token they reference already ships, so no dangling
refs.

### A3. Stop double-emitting in `@pantoken/components`
- `componentsCss()` (`formats/components/src/index.ts`) — drop the leading `elevationCss()` block (token
  sheet owns it now); components keep referencing `var(--instui-elevation-*)`.
- `baseCss()` — change the appended `focusOutlineCss()` to **`focusOutlineRules()` only** (keep the
  `:focus-visible` ring behavior; the var defs are now in the token sheet).
- Re-export the moved builders from `@pantoken/components` so existing importers + the public-surface
  test keep working; `elevationCss()`/`focusOutlineCss()` (doc-wrapped) and the cssdoc
  `elevation`/`focus` `Definition`s stay here, importing the moved pure builders.

### A4. Retire the web-components foundation injection
`renderers/web-components/src/index.ts` — remove `foundationCss()` and the `<style
id="pantoken-foundation">` injection in `register()` (redundant now the required token sheet carries
them); update the module JSDoc; drop the `foundationCss` export (`@alpha`, fine).

### A5. Keep other consumers working
`renderers/pendo/src/build.ts` (self-contained sheet) still imports `elevationCss`/`focusOutlineRules`/
`focusOutlineDeclarations` — available via the components re-exports; no change.
`docs/scripts/stage-component-assets.ts` (`focusOutlineCss`) and
`formats/components/scripts/generate.ts` (`ELEVATION_NAMES`) — unaffected via re-exports.

### A6. Tests
Update `formats/components/tests/sheets.test.ts` (`components.css` no longer leads with elevation
`:root`; `base.css` no longer defines `--instui-focus-outline-*`, only ring rules). Adjust IR-drift so
`@pantoken/css` **expects** the elevation/focus vars. Add a `@pantoken/css` test asserting both sheets
contain them. `public-surface.test.ts` passes via re-exports.

**Result — the CDN combine URL (foundation = lean sheet):**
```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/combine/npm/@pantoken/css@0/style.lean.css,npm/@pantoken/components@0/button.css,npm/@pantoken/components@0/badge.css">
```
`base.css` (reset) optional; `fonts.css` always a separate plain `<link>`.

---

## Part B — Web components

- **B1. Document ESM CDN (no code):** `<script type="module">import
